title: RUL Evaluation Audit: Reproducible Code and Aggregate Results

creators.name: Cai, Siyu
creators.affiliation: School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence, Southwest Jiaotong University

description:
Reproducible software, frozen protocols, split manifests, literature-practice coding tables, aggregate result tables, figures, and validation tests for a controlled audit of evaluation practices in NASA C-MAPSS remaining-useful-life prediction.

The release supports a 120-cell protocol Kill Test, a 160-cell unified point/quantile grid, a bounded 280-cell uncertainty-reference arm, and a secondary common-truth rescoring of all 120 Kill Test prediction artifacts. The common-truth plan pre-listed LSTM-versus-CNN checks; the implementation's wider model-pair scan is an exploratory descriptive extension. The release does not propose a new forecasting model or claim state-of-the-art performance.

NASA C-MAPSS source files and restricted literature PDFs are not redistributed. Generated per-window prediction and interval artifacts are deposited separately as a companion dataset.
